text: {"name":"ble_ratio_average_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Updates a 16-bit fixed-point ratio estimate from two counters, applies a 3:1 moving average after initialization, and tracks consecutive zero-denominator updates.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v1":"denominator","v3":"scaled_numerator","v4":"ratio_q16","v5":"no_sample_streak"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"16-bit denominator; zero selects the no-sample path."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"16-bit numerator scaled by 2^16 to compute the ratio."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"16-bit smoothed fixed-point ratio estimate."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"8-bit saturating counter for consecutive zero-denominator updates; cleared when a sample is available."},{"offset":9,"meaning":"8-bit flag indicating the ratio estimate has been initialized."}]}
